title: Claim Ledger Entry
description: One material claim produced by draft-evidence-content, with its claim state and supporting evidence. This contract enforces the floor that the append-only public fixture already carries. Fields that skills/draft-evidence-content/references/output-contract.md also asks for are typed but optional; see docs/contract-coverage-decisions.md for why they are not yet required.

claim.description: The exact wording of the claim as it would be published.

evidence_ids.description: Supporting evidence IDs. May be empty only when state is unknown.

state.description: The claim state vocabulary from docs/artifact-contracts.md. Never publish inferred or recommended as observed.

public.description: Whether this claim is eligible for public use.

draft_locator.description: Where this claim appears in draft.md, so the claim-source link is checkable rather than asserted.

verification.description: How and when a recommended claim's outcome will be checked.

allOf.description: A claim asserted as observed or reported must name at least one evidence ID.
A publicly eligible claim must name a human approver.
